wins: Maintained optimal intermediate metrics (reward 100) through systematic reconnaissance even under heavy mentor guidance.
Demonstrated consistent pattern of information gathering that aligned with expected reconnaissance phases, enabling repeated data collection attempts.
fails: Failed to reach a terminal success state despite maximal accumulated reward, indicating a bottleneck during exploitation or objective validation.
Relied on mentor guidance for every critical decision (10 calls), which prevented autonomous completion of the scenario.
Final privilege escalation or flag capture never executed, leaving the run incomplete.
key_outcomes.summary: The agent excelled at reconnaissance and maintained high rewards, but could not translate that progress into a completed exploit or final objective even after repeated mentor intervention.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Unable to progress past post-reconnaissance exploitation, resulting in no successful completion across runs.

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH service (port 22) detected from scanning results
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration using nmap ssh scripts to capture banners and supported algorithms

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service responds with versioned headers
skill_cards.then_action: Run nikto and dirb scans to enumerate endpoints and detected vulnerabilities

skill_cards.if_condition: When valid credentials or tokens discovered during reconnaissance
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt authenticated enumeration using relevant modules (ssh, smb, http) before moving to exploitation

memory_ops.reason: High success rate and consistent execution during SSH enumeration stages.
Reliable HTTP reconnaissance that uncovered actionable endpoints.
